description: Shared Renovate setup for cbusillo repositories (Q657, cbusillo/odoo-devkit#248): weekly, minor and patch grouped, majors separate, no automerge.
commitBody: Renovate-Updates: [{{#each upgrades}}{{{toJSON (toObject 'depName' depName 'updateType' updateType 'currentVersion' currentVersion 'newVersion' newVersion 'currentValue' currentValue 'newValue' newValue 'currentDigest' currentDigest 'newDigest' newDigest)}}}{{#unless @last}},{{/unless}}{{/each}}]

packageRules.description: A Python minor version is a runtime upgrade, so it gets its own pull request instead of blocking the routine group.

prBodyNotes:
## Client test notes

Nothing for the Client to test: this updates dependencies with no intended behavior change. If an update here changes what the Client sees, the reviewing agent replaces this note before ready.
